brief: As the Draycott Green 230/34kV unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023). Reduce permissible load by 1.5 percent of rating for each degree of average ambient above 30 degrees, assessed over the 24 hours preceding the loading decision (MG-021). On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward (MG-021). Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period (MG-021).
